text: Voy a llegar a Google Play, pero antes necesito doce testers durante catorce días.

I'm coming to Google Play, but first I need twelve testers for fourteen days.
All you need is an Android phone and a Gmail account.
Write to us on the Capri Discord or send a message on TikTok, and send us your Gmail address so we can add you to the test.
Install me, stay with me for two weeks… and help me get to Play. I'll be waiting!
